faq.q: Who from our side should be in the room?
faq.a: Decision-makers — owners, founders, GMs, department heads. The people who can actually approve a use case and own the ground rules. Bring the ones who'll be held to the outcome.

faq.q: Do we walk out with a finished, compliant AI policy?
faq.a: No — you walk out with a real first draft your own people wrote, plus an open-issues list. It then goes to your DPO, Legal, and InfoSec. I run the exercise; I don't author or certify the policy.

faq.q: How is this different from the vendors pitching us a platform?
faq.a: They sell you a product; I help you decide what's worth funding and set the rules before you spend. There's a published floor, and nothing to buy from me afterwards.
